title: Limits at Infinity with Radicals
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate lim_{x -> oo} sqrt(4x^2 + 1) / (3x - 2) and lim_{x -> -oo} sqrt(4x^2 + 1) / (3x - 2).

steps.title: Factor x from the Radical for x > 0
steps.explanation: Since x is positive as x -> oo, |x| = x.
steps.why: Square root of x^2 equals absolute value |x|.

steps.title: Evaluate Limit as x -> +oo
steps.explanation: Cancel factor x and evaluate limits of reciprocal terms.

steps.title: Factor x from the Radical for x < 0
steps.explanation: Since x is negative as x -> -oo, |x| = -x.

steps.title: Evaluate Limit as x -> -oo
steps.explanation: Cancel factor x, leaving a negative sign from |-x|.
steps.why: The negative sign arises from the direction of approach toward -oo.
